decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm's core air-cooling and heat-exchange know-how, and upgraded from a mere mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, it fits strongly with the firm's absorptive capacity and is likely to be retained.

This product is closely related to established condenser capabilities and its stronger 2024 website positioning suggests the firm has learned enough from early market feedback to justify continuing it.

The tube-liner solution builds on installed-base service knowledge and repair expertise, so despite more limited website prominence it remains a plausible keep product because the firm can absorb and apply learning from its service business.

A customized industrial air cooler is very near the firm's existing solution space, and in a growing market with active R&D and engineering resources the firm is more likely to refine than withdraw it.
Repair inserts for heat exchanger tube ends leverage the firm's deep maintenance, aftermarket, and component knowledge, making continuation more likely than exit even if it remains a niche offering.
